visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair, wearing a light pink T-shirt and gray shorts, sits on a gray sofa in a brightly lit indoor room. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures, discussing common fashion concerns. (2) The woman holds up two white tubes of 'L'Erbolario' brand products—Iris and Absinthium deodorant creams—presenting them closely to the lens. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand holding one of the white tubes with a purple cap; the product is squeezed out, and the unique applicator head is demonstrated against the skin of an arm. (4) The woman returns to the frame, holding both products while detailing their features and benefits, frequently gesturing with her free hand to emphasize her points. (5) Alternating close-up shots of the 'Absinthium' and 'Iris' tubes are interspersed as she describes their specific scents and ingredients. (6) The video concludes with the woman holding the products again, while large text overlays displaying discount codes and promotional information appear on the screen.
